confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Japanese regional prices for July 2026; no live listings or booking pages were inspected. Restaurant and cafe anchors are the most reliable, and accommodation rates swing with summer demand so they are least certain. Cocktail and wine_glass were set relative to the draft beer price (about 1.5x and 1.2x) because direct local knowledge is thinner. Local-currency examples were converted at an assumed 150 JPY per USD, not a checked rate. The 0.6955 FX value came from RBA search-result summaries rather than a direct page read, so confirm it on the RBA table before formal use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional Japanese basis: priced below Tokyo, Kyoto and Osaka tourist-core levels and close to other mid-sized Japanese cities such as Okayama and Sendai.
